hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Base and foundation
function: The steel skid that carries the Samson post, reducer, and prime mover and bolts to the concrete or timber foundation.

tabs.overview: Sets the geometry of the unit; leveled and anchored so the polished rod stays centered in the stuffing box.
tabs.engineering: Per API 11E; foundation per the unit size and soil.
tabs.safety: Anchor bolts checked; no one on the base while running.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
